summary: Library pieces: import, change, delete and analyze again the pieces a person uploaded.

commands.name: library.import
commands.summary: Import a MIDI or MusicXML file as a library piece

params.name: filename
params.help: The name of the uploaded file, kept as the piece's file name.

commands.reply: The job that imports and analyzes the file; its result holds the piece id.

commands.name: library.update
commands.summary: Change a piece's file name, composer, source, tags or notation

params.name: filename
params.help: The new file name; not empty.

params.name: notation
params.help: How the score is read: meter, value_scale and pickup, each a string; null clears it.

commands.reply: The piece as the Library shows it.
commands.example: library.update piece:piece-1 composer Bach tags [fugue organ]

commands.name: library.delete
commands.summary: Delete a library piece and its files

commands.name: library.reanalyze
commands.summary: Analyze a library piece again from its stored source
commands.reply: The job that analyzes the piece again.
